info.name: GitLab api/v4/ Admin Webhook Configuration API
GitLab Set a Webhook Custom Header

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: key
params.description: The name of the custom header.

items.docs: Adds or updates a custom HTTP header sent with every webhook delivery for the specified webhook. Custom headers are useful for authentication or routing at the receiving endpoint.

info.name: GitLab Delete a Webhook Custom Header

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: key
params.description: The name of the custom header to delete.

items.docs: Removes a custom HTTP header from the specified webhook. The header will no longer be included in future webhook deliveries.

info.name: GitLab Set a Webhook URL Variable

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: key
params.description: The name of the URL variable.

items.docs: Adds or updates a URL variable for the specified webhook. URL variables allow dynamic substitution in the webhook URL, enabling reuse of the same webhook configuration with different target endpoints.

info.name: GitLab Delete a Webhook URL Variable

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: key
params.description: The name of the URL variable to delete.

items.docs: Removes a URL variable from the specified webhook. The variable will no longer be substituted in future webhook deliveries.
